title: Rumour: Lucasfilm seeking a studio for Star Wars Battlefront 3; EA DICE and Bungie the frontrunners (EGM via Jeff Grubb)

sources.name: Electronic Gaming Monthly (EGM), rumour spotted by journalist Jeff Grubb in a YouTube video
sources.via: EGM's own page not found by search 05:35Z

claims.text: Lucasfilm has sent out feelers for a studio to make Battlefront 3
Frontrunners EA DICE (2015 and 2017 games) and Bungie (Destiny, Marathon; Sony-owned)
None of Lucasfilm, EA or Bungie have commented

media.source_url: Steam app 1237950 Celebration Edition trailer (uploads/bf2-rise.mp4), 100.5 s on
media.kind: Battlefront II footage, credited; letterboxed 816 rows, lowres_ok (only copies on an allowed route: this and a 720p trailer)

notes: Grammar review: no required edits; uncertain: Grubb spelt غرَب (DeepL غراب reads as crow); Star Wars Battlefront 3 is not an official title (headline says جزء ثالث). DeepL back-check matches; forward pass offered المرشحان الرئيسيان, kept الأبرز. Headline reworded after reel.py's wrap check stopped on a line opening with Star Wars.
